challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: New ministries, giga-projects and regional headquarters are opening buildings and campuses faster than ever. Infrastructure is often split across many contractors, so nobody owns the whole result when something fails.
points: Fragmented contracts for network, data centre, low-current and AV work
Tight handover dates on new buildings and campuses
Operations teams inheriting systems they did not design

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: A single accountable partner for the physical and digital foundation shortens delivery, reduces integration risk and gives operations one number to call. A sound foundation is also what every later AI, cloud and security investment depends on.
